summary.ko: 플랫폼·고객 사양에 맞춰 영상·오디오·자막·파일 상태를 검증합니다.
summary.en: Check a final video against supplied technical and editorial delivery requirements.

required_inputs.description: Rendered video or inspectable metadata and preview
Client or platform delivery specifications and approved content checklist

workflow.instruction: Create a checklist from the actual delivery requirements, including dimensions, frame rate, codec, duration, audio, and captions.
Inspect available technical metadata and sample beginning, middle, end, transitions, and high-risk scenes.
Check missing frames, spelling, clipping, sync, safe areas, credits, and required inclusions when the media is inspectable.
Return pass, fail, or unverified for each check with timestamped evidence and a correction list.

deliverables.name: Video QC report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Every check has requirement, observed value, evidence, status, and corrective action

limitations: Do not mark the whole file reviewed from only a thumbnail or metadata.
Playback on one device cannot guarantee all platform encodings.
permission_boundaries: Do not upload, publish, replace, or approve the final deliverable for the client.
Do not remove rights notices or infer licensing from file availability.
